title: Automations
description: Connect your data and actions. Build a workflow, run it, and see every step.
saveFirst: Save your changes before running this workflow.
canvasHint: Drag to arrange · select an output, then an input to connect
connectHint: Select a node’s input to connect · Escape to cancel
selectNode: Select a node to configure its behavior.
expressionHelp: Set fields with JSON values. Use {{ field.path }} to insert incoming data. Apply changes before saving.
triggerHelp: Run manually with the input below, call the authenticated event endpoint, or set an interval.
httpHelp: Public HTTP(S) endpoints only. Responses are limited to 100 KB. Redirects are not followed.
outputHelp: Capture the incoming data in the execution inspector.
noRuns: Run this workflow to see its execution history.
selectRun: Select an execution to inspect each step’s input and output.
readOnly: You can inspect this workflow. Editing requires workspace edit access.
scheduleHelp: 0 means manual/event runs only. A positive interval runs while the Automations worker is connected. Paused workflows never run on a schedule.
inputHelp: A JSON object passed to the trigger. Runs execute the saved revision.
fileTooLarge: Choose a JSON file smaller than 500 KB.
adjustFilters: Try a different search or clear the filters.
emptyDescription: Choose a template or connect a trigger to your own actions.
workflowUnavailable: This workflow is unavailable. Reload the list or go back.

starter.name: A simple flow
starter.description: Start with a trigger, prepare some data, and capture the result.

branch.name: Choose a path
branch.description: Route high-priority input down a different branch.

request.name: Fetch and inspect
request.description: Request public JSON and inspect the response.

applyFields: Apply the edited JSON fields before saving. Your field drafts are retained when you switch nodes.
